overall_summary: All historical videos currently have extremely low view counts (between 5 and 20 views) with zero likes or comments, indicating low sample size and insufficient distribution. Confidence is low, and we need a controlled exploration strategy focusing on high-friction relatable moments.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on phone contacts, old chats, and online status (e.g., A_eLARoegnw with 20 views and a9-G1X5jEOU with 18 views) performed slightly better than abstract concepts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on modern smartphone-related relationship triggers like saved numbers and chat histories.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic late-night solitude themes without a specific object
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के ख्याल' (uIbMpCjVutQ) scored the lowest (5 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid vague late-night ambiance hooks unless anchored to a specific physical or digital action.
